email.subject: Quick fix for Anchor Group's site
email.body:
Hi Ben,

I checked Anchor Group Plumbing's website and noticed it isn't set up for mobile, which matters since most people searching for a plumber in Harbor Falls do it from their phone. Your hours also aren't listed anywhere, so visitors can't tell if you're open before calling. Both likely send people straight to a competitor's site instead.

I fix issues like these for local businesses for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and how to fix it?

Alex
Northlight Web
